message.reasoning_content: We need to determine the crime(s) based on facts. The facts: defendant bought prohibited cultural relics (copper artifacts) from another person, intending to resell for profit. Then he deceived victim (俞某某) by promising high profit from buying cultural relics, got 5 million RMB, used money for personal purposes, gave back 1 million and some low-value artifacts. This is fraud (诈骗). Also dealing in illegal cultural relics: illegal acquisition, sale, or trafficking of cultural relics. The crime could be "非法买卖文物罪" (illegal trade of cultural relics) or "非法买卖文物罪" plus "诈骗罪". In examples, they used "非法持有、私藏枪支、弹药" etc. For cultural relics, typical Chinese criminal law: "非法买卖文物罪" (Article 322). Also "诈骗罪". So answer likely: [罪名]非法买卖文物;诈骗<eoa>. Need format exactly: [罪名]非法买卖文物;诈骗<eoa>. Provide JSON with reasoning and final answer.
